import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=np.asarray(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
# grid means RGB and hsv rough
for gy in range(6):
 row=[]
 for gx in range(8):
  a=im[gy*120:(gy+1)*120,gx*160:(gx+1)*160]
  row.append('/'.join(f'{x:.0f}' for x in a.mean((0,1))))
 print(gy,row)
print('HSV grid H/S/V')
for gy in range(6):
 row=[]
 for gx in range(8):
  a=hsv[gy*120:(gy+1)*120,gx*160:(gx+1)*160]
  row.append('/'.join(f'{x:.0f}' for x in a.mean((0,1))))
 print(gy,row)
# candidate masks hue orange/brown with sat > thresholds
for name,m in [
 ('warm',(hsv[...,0]<30)&(hsv[...,1]>45)&(hsv[...,2]>35)),
 ('orange',(hsv[...,0]>=5)&(hsv[...,0]<24)&(hsv[...,1]>90)&(hsv[...,2]>70)),
 ('brown',(hsv[...,0]>=0)&(hsv[...,0]<25)&(hsv[...,1]>40)&(hsv[...,2]<145)),
 ('bright',(hsv[...,2]>170)),('dark',(hsv[...,2]<35))]:
 n,lab,stats,cent=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m.astype('uint8'),8)
 print('\\n',name,'total',m.sum())
